# Photo Composition Critic Skill for Muse

Turns Muse into a grounded photo composition critic: it runs a six-step analysis protocol (first impression, technical scan, compositional analysis, aesthetic evaluation, contextual assessment, actionable recommendations) built on graduate-level visual aesthetics and computational aesthetics research (AVA, NIMA, LAION-Aesthetics, VisualQuality-R1). It evaluates compositional frameworks (visual weight, Gestalt principles, dynamic symmetry, arabesque eye-flow), scores color harmony by type, interprets ML aesthetic scores honestly — and ships anti-patterns with teeth: "higher NIMA score = better photo" is wrong, blind "rule of thirds" is an oversimplification, and genre context matters. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the deep theory files (composition-theory, color-theory, ml-models, analysis-scripts) live in the repo's references/ folder — fetch them with the SKILL.md; the ML-scoring paths need optional Hugging Face or Firecrawl setup, plain critique works without; it critiques, it doesn't edit — pair it with a retouching skill for the actual fixes. skills.sh Trust Hub: unverified. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
